name: VictoriaLogs
summary: Search your server's and apps' logs in the browser, with live tail, history and a cap on disk use.
description: The Apache-2.0 VictoriaLogs log database from VictoriaMetrics, packaged from a pinned upstream release with its web UI (open /select/vmui/). Once an administrator approves its logs:receive permission, the Automaton API, Worker and the Runner that hosts it send their logs to it over OpenTelemetry, with no setting. It keeps 14 days and at most 2 GiB of logs by default.

application.description: Search your server's and apps' logs in the browser, with live tail, history and a cap on disk use.

settings.name: RETENTION_PERIOD
settings.description: How long logs are kept, for example 14d, 4w or 1d. Older days are dropped.

settings.name: MAX_DISK_SPACE_BYTES
settings.description: At most this much disk for logs, for example 2GiB or 500MiB; the oldest days are dropped first. 0 turns the cap off.

settings.name: LOGS_URL
settings.description: Address the Home card Action uses to ask this app for recent errors. Empty (the default): the card uses this app's own address, so it works right after install.
